page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor built on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio with no hyperthreading. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.c8a.xlarge demonstrates strong single-core performance, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core CPU tests and Geekbench text processing. Multi-core CPU performance, PassMark CPU scores, and single-threaded gzip compression fall within the average tier. However, the instance exhibits weaknesses in memory bandwidth, particularly for read-only operations, and shows lower-tier performance in database operations, Redis SET benchmarks, and static web serving throughput.

From a resource-density and cost perspective, the instance offers a dedicated compute profile suitable for CPU-bound tasks that do not require large memory footprints or local disk storage. The lack of bundled local storage and the 2.0 GB per core memory allocation represent clear tradeoffs, making it less suitable for memory-intensive databases or high-throughput web serving. Appropriate workloads include single-threaded processing, text processing, and lightweight compute-bound applications.
